title: Replication materials for: Calibrating Synthetic Respondents — A Within-Persona Experiment on Public Reactions to Protest in Turkey
description: Code, prompts, configuration, aggregated results, and figures for the paper. Persona corpora and raw model completions are archived separately in the Zenodo record. TGSS 2024 microdata is obtained from Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.18721350 under CC BY-NC 4.0 and is not redistributed here.
